title: CKB RPC methods markdown table — exactly 5
prompt: List exactly 5 CKB RPC methods. For each, provide: method name, one-line description, example request JSON, example response JSON. Format as a markdown table with columns: | Method | Description | Example Request | Example Response |. Do not include any methods not in the official CKB RPC spec. Do not include any introduction, preamble, or conclusion — just the table.
